name: The Wicker Man

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Block on the facing page (PDF 579). The block itself has no Secret; the chapter ties its damage threshold to the living Old Ways Chosen.

languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Burning Aura
traits.summary: At the end of each of its turns, creatures it chooses within 15 ft take 1d10 Fire and start burning; flammable objects there ignite too.
traits.text: At the end of each of the Wicker Man's turns, every creature of its choice within 15 feet takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in that area start burning.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.summary: Four times a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Wicker Man fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 4 times a day.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.summary: Can take one Reaction on every turn of combat, not only once a round.
traits.text: The Wicker Man can take a Reaction on every turn of combat, its own included.

traits.name: Soul Motes
traits.summary: Holds 3 Soul Motes (reset to 3 on a long rest), gaining 1 when a non-Construct, non-Undead creature dies within 30 ft; they fuel its two Reactions.
traits.text: The Wicker Man has 3 Soul Motes. It gains 1 more whenever a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead dies within 30 feet of it. It can spend motes to power its Soul Mote Reactions, and when it finishes a Long Rest the total goes back to 3.

traits.name: Regional Effects (Lair)
traits.summary: Within a mile of its hill: Fire damage to a Fire-resistant or Fire-immune creature outside its cult adds 1d6 Necrotic, and cult hymns carry 300 ft, even through Silence.
traits.text: Regional effects, within 1 mile of the hilltop where it stands while the Wicker Man lives and keeps its lair there. Biting Flames: when Fire damage is dealt to a creature outside the Wicker Man's cult that has Resistance or Immunity to Fire, it takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage. Endless Praise: cultists of the Wicker Man who sing its praises or hymns can be heard up to 300 feet away, even through a Silence spell. Both end the moment it dies or moves its lair.

actions.name: Cremating Flame

params.when: a creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage, on a failed or a successful save
params.effect: turned to ash, soul taken into the Wicker Man, can't be restored to life by any means until it is destroyed

actions.summary: Recharge 6. 60-ft cone, DC 18 Dex save: 10d6 Fire (half on a success); a creature this drops to 0 is burned to ash and its soul is bound in the Wicker Man until it is destroyed.
actions.text: A column of fire rolls out in a 60-foot cone. DC 18 Dexterity save: 35 (10d6) Fire damage on a failure, half on a success. Whether or not it saved, a creature brought to 0 Hit Points by this fire is burned to ash and its soul is drawn into the Wicker Man; it can't be restored to life by any means until the Wicker Man is destroyed.

actions.name: Burning Clutch
actions.summary: Legendary only, once a round. One creature within 15 ft: DC 19 Str save or Grappled (escape DC 16, one of two hands) and Restrained; the held creature takes 3d6 Fire at the start of the Wicker Man's turns.

reactions.name: Crushing Blow (Soul Mote)
reactions.trigger: The Wicker Man hits with an attack roll.
reactions.summary: Spends 1 Soul Mote: the hit becomes a Critical Hit.

reactions.name: Repair (Soul Mote)
reactions.summary: Spends 1 Soul Mote: it regains 20 Hit Points.

options.name: Burning Clutch
options.summary: One creature within 15 ft: DC 19 Str save or Grappled and Restrained, burning 3d6 a turn. Once a round.

options.name: Slam
options.summary: One Blazing Slam attack; not again until its next turn.

options.name: Stride
options.summary: Moves up to half its Speed with no Opportunity Attacks.

summary: A burning wicker colossus caged with its victims: heavy flaming slams, a roaring cone of fire that burns the dead to ash, a scorching aura, and motes of stolen souls that turn blows into crits and mend it.
